Done

What this page does

  1. Fetch — it requests dist/AE.exe from the repository over the GitHub API, which serves the exact committed bytes.
  2. Verify — it recomputes the SHA-256 in your browser with crypto.subtle and refuses to save a mismatch.
  3. Save — it hands the verified bytes to the browser as a download named AE.exe.

No build happens here and nothing is uploaded: the file is already in the repository, and this page only exists because GitHub serves repository files as text/plain, which a browser displays instead of downloading.
